_comment: Overrides the harness's default agent identity with the account root user. Root
bypasses every deny in the permissions boundary (§9.4), so it is the one caller for
which this script has no backstop at all - and the refusal has to be in the script,
because nothing underneath will catch the mistake (G-067).
The fixture directory contains only this file: everything else falls through to the
harness defaults, and the run must refuse before it reads any of them.
